name: Wi-Fi airboat
note: Recycled-bottle catamaran with two air propellers. The ESP32 makes its own Wi-Fi network and serves a tablet steering page; steer by spinning one fan faster than the other.

name: Wi-Fi paper plane
note: A ~21 g card-stock dart with two tiny motors and a XIAO ESP32-C3. A two-stick controller page on the phone; no servos, it turns by differential thrust.

name: Pocket game console
note: ESP32-S3 handheld that plays games Kai invents. Every game is tested on the PC with a robot player before it's flashed.

name: 3D-printed parts
note: Shaft coupler and motor holders written in OpenSCAD (code that makes shapes). Change one number, print again.
